decisions.reason: Although it fits the firm's laser-marking knowledge base, its weaker web prominence and likely overlap with the newer laser cabin and broader industrial laser systems make it the most plausible candidate for portfolio rationalisation.

A high-resolution thermal inkjet printer sits close to the firm's established coding and marking capabilities, and its dedicated presence across both years suggests enough traction for the firm to keep refining it.

The piezo inkjet printer also builds on core printing know-how, and a large experienced German machinery firm is likely to retain it because it can learn from early market use and improve it through in-house engineering.

Being highlighted on the home page in its launch year indicates strategic importance, and industrial laser marking systems are highly related to the firm's absorptive base and therefore worth sustaining.
The newly launched compact laser marking cabin appears to be a focused extension of the firm's laser competence, so management would likely keep it and exploit the learning from adjacent products.

Despite being more niche, the lubricant printing system leverages the firm's high-resolution application knowledge and the trade-fair award provides a strong external signal to continue commercial development.
